_doc: Feedback scenarios (SIMULATION_SPEC.md section 7.4). Gain of an arm, in logits: gain = intercept + slope * x, where x = theta - delta (relative expertise). Each gain is clipped to [gain_clip_low, gain_clip_high] and multiplied by gain_scale (configs/learner.default.json). 'plain' has gain 0 in every scenario. Expertise reversal: Kalyuga et al. (2003).

S0.label: null: no real difference between arms

S2.label: expertise reversal: best arm depends on learner and task
